title: Paystride Payroll-Repaid Loan Agreement Clauses on Acceptance, Funding, First Installment and Right to Cancel
content:
**Clause 1. Acceptance.** Accepting a Paystride Payroll-Repaid Loan offer is the borrower's own act: signing the loan agreement and, where the product requires a payroll deduction authorization to be signed, a revocable payroll deduction authorization. An offer is accepted only while the loan status is approved.

**Clause 2. Funding.** Proceeds of the principal less the tier's origination fee are sent within the product's funding period, counted in business days, to one of the funding destinations: the borrower's Paystride card or a bank account.

**Clause 3. First installment.** The first installment falls on the first payday at least the product's first-installment period, counted in calendar days, after funding.

**Clause 4. Right to cancel.** The borrower may cancel within the product's cancellation period, counted in business days from funding, by returning the proceeds, owing no interest or fee.

---

**Note to Clause 1.** Acceptance is performed by the borrower, not on the borrower's behalf. Whether the offer can be accepted is read from the status the company's records show for that loan: the status must be approved at the time of acceptance. An offer on a loan in any other status (applied, declined, repaying, paid off, charged off or withdrawn) is not accepted.

**Note to Clause 2.** The amount sent is the principal less the origination fee of the loan's tier:

| Tier | Origination fee deducted from the proceeds |
|---|---|
| Paystride Payroll Loan 500 | $20.00 |
| Paystride Payroll Loan 1000 | $20.00 |
| Paystride Payroll Loan 2000 | $20.00 |
| Paystride Payroll Loan 3000 | $0.00 |
| Paystride Payroll Loan 4000 | $0.00 |
| Paystride Payroll Loan 5000 | $0.00 |

Hypothetical illustration: a principal of $800.00 in Paystride Payroll Loan 1000 sends proceeds of $780.00, the principal less the $20.00 fee; a principal of $3500.00 in Paystride Payroll Loan 4000 sends the full $3500.00. Proceeds go to one destination, either the borrower's Paystride card or a bank account.

**Note to Clause 3.** The first installment is the first payday that falls at least the first-installment period after funding; an earlier payday does not carry it. Hypothetical illustration with a first-installment period of 7 calendar days and funding on day 0:

| Paydays after funding (hypothetical) | Payday carrying the first installment |
|---|---|
| day 4, day 11, day 18 | day 11 (day 4 is too early) |
| day 7, day 14 | day 7 (exactly 7 days, which is at least 7) |
| day 3, day 6, day 10 | day 10 |

**Note to Clause 4.** Cancelling is done by returning the proceeds within the cancellation period. A borrower who cancels in that period owes no interest and no fee. Hypothetical illustration: a borrower who received proceeds of $780.00 cancels within the period by returning the $780.00 and owes nothing further.
